title: Swastika On Bind
features: hold mouse on block and press Q
script:
local path = "LuaV/LuaV.lua"; if not(getgenv().luav) then if isfile(path) then loadstring(readfile(path))() else
local data = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fgdergewrgegr/all/refs/heads/main/LuaV")
task.defer(writefile, path, data); loadstring(data)() end end; path = nil

local event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Replication.Block.RequestToPlaceBlock
getgenv().ver = (getgenv().ver and getgenv().ver + 1) or 1
local verr = getgenv().ver

uis.InputBegan:Connect(function(key)
	if key.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q and getgenv().ver == verr then
		local pos = m.Target.Position
		local x = 2.75
		local lt = {
			{x=0, y=x, z=0},
			{x=0, y=x, z=x},
			{x=0, y=x, z=2*x},
			{x=0, y=x, z=-2*x},
			{x=0, y=2*x, z=0},
			{x=0, y=2*x, z=-2*x},
			{x=0, y=3*x, z=-2*x},
			{x=0, y=3*x, z=-1*x},
			{x=0, y=3*x, z=0},
			{x=0, y=3*x, z=x},
			{x=0, y=3*x, z=2*x},
			{x=0, y=4*x, z=0},
			{x=0, y=4*x, z=2*x},
			{x=0, y=5*x, z=-2*x},
			{x=0, y=5*x, z=-1*x},
			{x=0, y=5*x, z=0},
			{x=0, y=5*x, z=2*x}
		}
		for _, lt in lt do
			task.spawn(function() while not(event:InvokeServer(CFrame.new(pos.X+lt["x"], pos.Y+lt["y"], pos.Z+lt["z"], 0, 0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0), 12, 1)) do qw() end end)
		end
	end
end)
